title: Accelerated Gradient Flow with Endogenous Gradient-Memory Anchor: Selection and Restoring Damping
summary: We introduce an accelerated gradient flow with an endogenous gradient-memory anchor and a nonlinear restoring--damping feedback. The anchor evolves from a weighted history of the gradients, while the nonlinear feedback is modulated by the squared coordinatewise displacement from the anchor. The resulting dynamics uses only first-order information from the objective function and does not involve explicit Hessian information. Under suitable assumptions, we establish global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions. A Lyapunov analysis yields the accelerated objective-value estimate…
